text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that Satono Diamond is no longer training with her, Kitasan Black isn't doing as well…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Dia… isn't here… She isn't chasing after me anymore…)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Why does everything feel so different without her?! Urgh…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them were like inseparable sisters, so now that her other half is missing, she clearly isn't in top form.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer. I'm not exactly doing great, am I?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Man, and I'd made up my mind to be Dia's big sister and everything, too…
choice_data_list: Won't that be pretty tough to do, though?
Won't that be pretty tough to do, though?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um… Well… I'd always compared myself to Dia ever since we were little.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I always think about how I have to work harder than Dia or what would Dia do in certain situations… Stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Satono Diamond is more than just Kitasan Black's childhood friend. She was the beacon that led them down the right path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No wonder Kitasan Black is having trouble staying the course after losing a pillar like her. In which case…
choice_data_list: Sit tight for a minute, okay?
Sit tight for a minute, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where are you heading, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I have to help her solve this problem, and to do that…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even Trainer's gone, too… Ngh… I'm all alone…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to do with myself… I've always had someone with me, but now that I'm alone…
Wahey-hey! ☆ If you're feelin' lonely, why don't you hang with us, Kita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Daitaku Helios?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello! Thank you for everything you did during the freshman welcoming party!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No probs! It's been forevs since we talked! But hey, I'm not the only one here! C'mon, fam!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm here too! Wahey-heeey! But wait, there's more!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo, reporting for duty! I'm at full throttle today! Together we are…

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: The Breakaway Trio! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The Breakaway Trio… Oh, I get it! You call yourselves that because you're all front runners who are good at breaking away from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! If you've got any questions about front running, we'll be happy to answer them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks, but I'm not actually having any trouble with my running… It's more like… I don't know how to get out of the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aah. I get it. Your vibes are all off, and you get outta your funk, huh? Well, never fear, 'cause we are here! C'mon, get hyped with us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I dunno… I don't think "hype" is what she needs right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This doesn't feel like a motivation problem—you're just missing someone to run with, I'm guessing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-actually, yes, when you put it that way. But how'd you know, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Call it a hunch. You look more lost and confused than worried and stressed, y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's exactly how I feel! Dia and I have always trained together and encouraged each other, but she can't run with me anymore…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh, so that's the sitch. Well, how 'bout you hang out with us for now? The more the merrier and whatnot, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You can join us and make the Breakaway Trio into the Breakaway Quartet! Let's get out there and tear up the turf!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: L-like literally? That sounds pretty extreme, but I'll do my best to keep up!
Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm making my way back with a training partner that should be perfect for Kitasan Black, only to find her already surrounded by other runners.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You should come talk to us if you have troubles, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-T-Teio?! Trainer, did you leave so you could bring Teio here?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And who's that over there?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey. Nice Nature, at your service and whatnot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm just here for these three stooges. Ikuno told me to send them her way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This runner is Nice Nature. She's in the same year as Tokai Teio and is on good terms with the Breakaway Trio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since so many Umamusume are here already, we take advantage of the situation and discuss Kitasan Black's next move together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're just so by the book, Kita. I don't think reckless strategies or running styles are your thing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You'd get a lot more out of studying with me and McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm here in the first place 'cause your trainer feels the same way and came to get me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm… So you think she should study, huh? What do you think, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Me? Well… Considering the options…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'd say it's better if Kita followed Teio's advice.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: But why? Kita's clearly well-suited for front running!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I never said she wasn't, but unlike you, she doesn't go in an all-or-nothing frenzy when she runs.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Plus, she hasn't decided if she wants to specialize in front running, so I think it's better for her to learn more about running styles with Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's just as Nice Nature says. Kitasan Black may have an affinity for front running, but she doesn't run recklessly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's always conscious of the racers behind her as she keeps the lead and holds out to the end with her tough tenacity. I want her to learn other running styles outside of front running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I guess that's everything, nice and figured out. The most important thing is what's best for Kita's future, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For sure! ☆ As long as Kita cheers up, then that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Later, Kita! Let's hang out again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hit me up if you ever need help with anything! I'm always happy to listen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After wrapping things up with the older Umamusume…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Kita. As you may know, I am Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, a friend of Tokai Teio and a stayer who hails from the illustrious Mejiro family, extends a warm welcome to us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I heard you wish to learn as much as you can from us. Of course, we would be glad to oblige.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Spe and some others are around as well, so go ahead and ask us for help whenever you have a question.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well? Do you think you'll be all right hanging out with us, even though we're upperclassmen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Getting to learn from you and McQueen is like a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm Kitasan Black! As a newbie, I'm ready for whatever initiation awaits! I'll carry your bags, clean, and anything you want me to do!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for this opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… There's no initiation, so you don't have to clean or anything, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's how Kitasan Black gains a new support system and circle of friends.
